# Flower (white): a cyan stem with two leaves, a head of 8 white petals round a gold centre,
# tilted 40 degrees towards the camera. Origin at the stem's foot. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Petal --base-color 1.0000 0.9686 0.9725 --no-slot
material new Centre --base-color 1.0000 0.8549 0.2706 --no-slot
material new Stem --base-color 0.2863 0.9059 0.9255 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Centre --vertices 8 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.12 --location 0 0 0.02
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0.000 0.300 0
scale 1.0 0.62 0.32
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 90.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location -0.212 0.212 0
scale 1.0 0.62 0.32
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 135.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location -0.300 0.000 0
scale 1.0 0.62 0.32
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 180.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location -0.212 -0.212 0
scale 1.0 0.62 0.32
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 225.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location -0.000 -0.300 0
scale 1.0 0.62 0.32
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 270.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt5 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0.212 -0.212 0
scale 1.0 0.62 0.32
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 315.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt6 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0.300 -0.000 0
scale 1.0 0.62 0.32
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 360.0
apply --rotation
add mesh ico-sphere --name Pt7 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0.212 0.212 0
scale 1.0 0.62 0.32
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 405.0
apply --rotation
select Pt0 Pt1 Pt2 Pt3 Pt4 Pt5 Pt6 Pt7
active Pt0
join
rename Pt0 Petals
material assign Petal
select Centre
material assign Centre
select Petals Centre
active Centre
join
rename Centre Head
set rotation 40 0 0
apply --rotation
set location 0 -0.08 0.95
apply --location
add mesh cylinder --name Stalk --vertices 6 --radius 0.07 --depth 0.95 --location 0 0 0.47
add mesh cube --name LeafL --size 1 --location -0.2 0 0.35
scale 0.36 0.16 0.07
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -30 0
add mesh cube --name LeafR --size 1 --location 0.2 0 0.5
scale 0.36 0.16 0.07
apply --scale
set rotation 0 30 0
select Stalk LeafL LeafR
active Stalk
join
rename Stalk Stem
material assign Stem
select Head Stem
active Stem
join
rename Stem Flower
shade flat
export flower_white.glb
